entries.name: Commander Shepard
entries.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2 (2010), default male Soldier Shepard
entries.sourceReference: ME2 Soldier has Adrenaline Rush and Concussive Shot and can use the M-8 Avenger assault rifle. Adrenaline Rush is adapted to a short bounded personal attack buff; the global simulation clock is unchanged. Concussive Shot is the ordinary single-target combat shot, not the optional Concussive Blast area evolution. Cover is personal physical protection. No ME3 omni-blade, Adept Singularity, Sentinel Tech Armor, Mako attack or inherited caller class power.

entries.name: Garrus Vakarian
entries.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2 (2010), scarred Garrus after Archangel recruitment
entries.sourceReference: ME2 Garrus uses assault and sniper rifles. His powers are Concussive Shot, Overload, Turian Rebel and loyalty Armor-Piercing Ammo. The selected super is the ordinary single-target Concussive Shot from his weapon, not an invented Killbox or a proximity mine. Overload is his real tech attack, adapted to one electrical impact without changing its identity to biotics. Personal cover does not grant an allied shield.

entries.name: Liara T'Soni
entries.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2: Lair of the Shadow Broker (2010)
entries.sourceReference: DLC squad Liara has Singularity, Warp, Asari Scientist and Stasis, and uses heavy pistols or submachine guns. The selected M-3 Predator supplies her basic shot, Warp her secondary biotic projectile, and Singularity her localized biotic field. The field and its duration, damage and crowd control are bounded gameplay adaptations; no Shadow Broker data storm, electronic attack, ME1 Barrier loadout or instant environmental execution is asserted.

entries.name: Tali Zorah
entries.sourceReference: Selected ME2 sealed purple enviro-suit. Combat Drone is a genuine tech projection; its Attack Drone evolution damages the target with an electrical shock. One finite shock is condensed here. Explosive Drone is a different evolution that explodes when destroyed, so the ordinary deployment is not an instantaneous group explosion. No unsealed face, alien pet, magical summon or transferred quarian biology.

entries.name: Urdnot Wrex
entries.sourceWork: Mass Effect (2007), heavy red-armored krogan Wrex
entries.sourceReference: Selected ME1 heavy red krogan armor. Barrier surrounds and strengthens its own user, Wrex; the project adapts the temporary personal shields to bounded self guard. It is not a group shield, heal or damage attack. Legendary Edition reference describes the original ME1 talent semantics, not original2007 frame equivalence.
